RE: Account reference: ACC-680358

Dear [CONSUMER NAME],

Re: Dispute of Account ACC-680358

We acknowledge receipt of your dispute regarding the account referenced above. You have disputed the debt as already paid. We will investigate this dispute and verify the accuracy of the information on file.

Pursuant to the Fair Debt Collection Practices Act (FDCPA), 15 U.S.C. § 1692g, we are required to provide you with a validation notice. This notice is being sent to you as you have requested validation of the debt. The validation notice will include the original creditor, the amount of the debt, and the reason for the debt.

Regarding your claim of an out-of-network provider charging you without prior authorization, we note that this issue appears to be related to the original creditor, Valley Regional Hospital, and not our agency. We will not be addressing this matter in our investigation.

We will investigate the dispute you have raised regarding the payment status of the account. If our investigation confirms that the debt has been paid, we will take the necessary steps to update our records and remove the debt from our collection efforts.

You have the right to dispute this matter further if you feel that our investigation is incomplete or inaccurate. Please contact us at [AGENCY PHONE NUMBER] to discuss this matter further.

Sincerely,

[AGENCY NAME]

cc: [AGENCY FILE]

Note: The No Surprise Act is not relevant to this dispute as it is a federal law related to surprise medical billing, and the dispute raised by the consumer does not pertain to a surprise medical bill.
